name: nextjs-math-course
description: 📚 Next.js 16 platform for selling math courses, with a headless CMS, auth, video lessons, quizzes, LaTeX, interactive graphs, and an MCP server for AI-assisted content management.

paragraphs: A modern full-stack Next.js 16 platform with CMS, auth, and Stripe integration - built to manage and sell online math courses with videos, quizzes, LaTeX, and interactive graphs.
features: Full Authentication - powered by BetterAuth, featuring Google OAuth, Google One Tap, email verification & password reset via Resend. Includes block for disposable emails, last used method badge, session limits and rate…
Admin CMS Dashboard - manage courses, lessons, and media directly through an integrated headless Payload CMS interface with drafts, version history, and scheduled publishing via QStash job queues.
Scheduled Course Publishing — automatically publish courses on schedule with failure detection and admin email alerts.
AI Feedback Classification — automatically classify lesson feedback by category, importance, sentiment, and spam using Jev by TypeSafe AI, with automatic retries.
MCP integration - a Model Context Protocol server lets AI clients like Claude draft, edit, and review lesson content directly against the CMS.

whatItDoes.text: A modern full-stack Next.js 16 platform with CMS, auth, and Stripe integration - built to manage and sell online math courses with videos, quizzes, LaTeX, and interactive graphs.

requirements.text: Create your admin account on first visit
Go to /admin → MCP → API Keys → Create New, enable the required collections/operations, save, and copy the generated key.
